pages.text:
Reforms Naphtha into Gasoline, giving off Hydrogen.
- 100 mB Naphtha makes 85 mB Gasoline and 60 mB Hydrogen in 2 seconds, using 20 HU/t at 450°C or hotter.
- Naphtha in the top, heat into the bottom (a Fuel Burner or a Firebox works), Gasoline out of the left and Hydrogen out of the right. It pushes both out on its own.
- Speed Upgrades make it faster, drawing heat that much faster.
The Hydrogen is worth keeping: it makes Plastic, Hydrochloric Acid and Ammonia, or burns.
